A_first_order.equation: dF/dt = clip((F_cmd(t - latency_s) - F) / tau_eq_s, -R_close(P_tank, F), +R_open(P_tank, F))
A_first_order.tags: latency ASSUMED; tau_eq DERIVED (2 zeta / w_n of the ASSUMED servo loop)

B_two_state.equation: v_cmd = clip((F_cmd(t - latency_s) - F) / tau_p_s, -R_close(P_tank, F), +R_open(P_tank, F)); tau_v_s dv/dt = v_cmd - v; dF/dt = v

parameters.closing_rate_table: R_close_assist_credited (by_law) for fidelity; R_close for the bound

B_two_state.tags: latency ASSUMED; tau_p, tau_v FIT to the nonlinear drive simulation (3.5 MPa runs, grid tau_p [0.004, 0.006, 0.0085, 0.01] s x tau_v [0.002, 0.004, 0.006, 0.008, 0.01] s, minimum of the maximum shape error), checked on 4.5 / 5.5 MPa (holdout_P_not_fit)

reduced_model_for_gnc.recommended: B_two_state with the envelope tables (R_open; R_close for robustness runs, the assist-credited closing for nominal trajectories); A_first_order is the simplest form and leads the simulation by up to the validation dt10 at the start of large steps
reduced_model_for_gnc.rate_tables: rate_map.<case>.R_open_N_per_s / R_close_N_per_s (envelope = minimum over L0/L1/L2); bilinear in (P_tank, F); F from the [P][frac] F_N array
reduced_model_for_gnc.includes: HV69 torque-speed line under the needle-force + spring + friction load, crank kinematics, thrust-map gain, servo latency and loop lag (pintle_dynamics_v3 model)
excludes: ECU Pc loop (PI) and its static-droop removal; the drive alone holds a static offset (validation sim_static_offset_end_N) that the Pc loop integrates out
chamber filling and fuel thermal lag (Combustion)
FC_THRUST -> CAN -> ECU latency (RG-19 budget, Electronics, open)
start transient (IGNITION -> RUN is capped by kStartRamp_Nps in firmware) and shutdown (kPintleCloseRate_mps)
reduced_model_for_gnc.closed_loop_reference: SIL v2.8.2 S4 (ECU firmware + ASSUMED plant): 150 +/- 25 N sine at 1 Hz -> gain 1.024, phase -8.7 deg (about 24 ms equivalent delay end to end, SIL)

corner.label: spring +10 % opening / -10 % closing, servo plug at the rail static minimum

corner_friction_sens.label: corner + MECH guide-friction sensitivity (mu_g 0.02, S 5 N)
corner_friction_sens.role: sensitivity only (MECH v2.4 sensitivity row), not a design case

validation_vs_nonlinear_drive_sim.method: normalized responses (pre-step value to final mean) compared at 10/50/90 %; shape error = max |g_sim - g_reduced| x |dF|; per law with that law's rate table

cross_check.what: pintle_dynamics_v3 Tables (+10 % spring, L0/L1/L2) vs MECH pintle_crank_table_v1 Topen columns at the 45 hot-fire rows

spring_follow_up.question: would less spring torque at full lift change the result? hard constraint: unpowered closing at the MEOP-equivalent load

constraints_used.C1: L0, -10 % spring: closing assist >= 0 over the stroke at 3.5 / 5.5 / 7.0 MPa (targets 0.05 at MEOP, 0.08 at 5.5 MPa) (MECH pintle_inline_v34_v2p4 criteria; targets parsed)
constraints_used.hot_line: unpowered closing assist >= 0 at -10 % spring along the hot-fire grid (L0/L1/L2, 3.5-5.5 MPa) [DESIGN, Electronics]
constraints_used.seat: seat preload T0 at the closed angle unchanged (seat leak specification)

spring_follow_up.note: the floor profile is a bound, not a spring design (a falling-rate spring is a Mechanical design item); the unpowered closing time grows as the assist falls (B-PNT-1 kPintleUnpoweredClose_s/3 rule)

b_pnt_1_torque_speed_points.rule: B-PNT-1 adds: HV69 output speed under a steady load torque at the listed points (3.5 and 5.5 MPa throttle-line opening torque, worst law, +10 % spring for the corner) at the corner and nominal plug voltages; pass when the measured speed >= model_speed_rad_s; otherwise this rate map is re-run with the measured line (ASSUMED linear line replaced)

limitations: HV69 torque-speed line from retailer copies of MKS data (stall torque, s/60 deg at no load); linear line ASSUMED; not measured under load (B-PNT-1)
needle-force laws L0/L1/L2 bound an unknown true law; the envelope takes the worst; friction MECH baseline (ASSUMED coefficients), sensitivity case given
the thrust map is piecewise linear in lift between 9 Combustion rows per P_tank: dF/dx and the rates step between rows; the true curve is smooth (Combustion SIM)

the quasi-static rate omits the acceleration time (tau_m 10 ms ASSUMED) and the servo saturation entry; the reduced model validation quantifies the combined effect against the nonlinear simulation, which itself rests on the same ASSUMED servo model
eng03_slew_check_v1 Part A closing used the no-load speed (assist neglected); this map debits a resisting closing load (count in summary.closing_load_resisting_states)
